subject: Request and delivery: IR artifacts + SOC 2 telemetry snapshot for Splendid Fintech
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: SAML Security Team <sec@splendid-fintech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR artifacts & SOC 2 telemetry snapshot

Hi Kimberly,

Splendid Fintech experienced an authentication anomaly on 2026-10-29 that impacted a small subset of sessions. Our security team needs a short evidence package to support an upcoming SOC 2 review and an initial incident timeline for our board briefing. Specifically we need: 

- A telemetry snapshot (application logs + auth events) for 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30, redacted for PII;
- Any IR timeline notes or runbook executions tied to the event;
- Confirmation of the key rotation and KMS events if there were any related keys used;

Can you confirm Pratt & Reed's (our auditor) request below and provide an ETA for the artifacts? Ideally we need the package by COB 2026-11-03.

Thanks — and please include any SOC 2/ SIG crosswalk material if available.

Best,
Asha Menon
Head of Security Operations
Splendid Fintech

---
Attachment: request-scope-splendid-20261030.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts & SOC 2 telemetry snapshot

Hi Asha — thanks for flagging this and outlining the auditor scope.

On Fri, Oct 30, 2026 at 08:12 AM Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com> wrote:
> Hi Kimberly,
> 
> Splendid Fintech experienced an authentication anomaly on 2026-10-29 ...

We can deliver the requested items. Quick clarifying questions so we scope cleanly: 

1) Exact retention window: you listed 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30 — should we include +/- 24 hours for correlated traces? (We can include 10/27 00:00 - 10/31 23:59 if Pratt & Reed prefers a buffer.)
2) Redaction level: Do you need token-level redaction, or is IP + user-id pseudonymization sufficient for the auditor?
3) KMS/key events: do you want the raw KMS event logs (we'll redact key material) or a summarized confirmation from our security ops?

I've looped in Marissa (evidence coordination) and Jonas (IR lead) to help. If you confirm the three items above today, we'll aim for an initial evidence bundle matching your COB 11/03 target — otherwise we'll provide an interim snapshot by 11/01 and the full packet on 11/03.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Partner, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

---
Internal note: Marissa/Jonas — please advise on redaction tooling and expected packaging size (we often hit 2–5GB for 72h telemetry).
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: SAML Security Team <sec@splendid-fintech.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts & SOC 2 telemetry snapshot

Kimberly — thanks. Answers below: 

1) Please include a 24h buffer either side (so 2026-10-27 00:00 through 2026-10-31 23:59 UTC). Our SIEM correlation will need the extra window.
2) Pseudonymization is fine — replace account IDs with stable hashed IDs and remove full email addresses; IPs can be truncated to /24.
3) Summarized KMS event log plus a signed confirmation from your security leadership is sufficient for auditors at this stage; no raw key material please.

Also — we'll schedule a short IR tabletop (30 minutes) next week to walk through the timeline before the SOC 2 submission. Can you propose 3 times?

One more ask: Pratt & Reed also requested a SIG->SOC 2 crosswalk document showing where evidence maps to criteria. If you have an internal artifact it will accelerate their review.

Linking the Pratt & Reed request: https://docu-sign.example/ds/abcd1234

Best,
Asha

---
Attachment: auditor-scope-pratt-reed-20261029.docx (docx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:44:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence fulfillment: initial artifacts and proposed tabletop slots

Hi Asha —

Thanks for confirming. We're attaching an initial fulfillment bundle and proposing tabletop times below.

What we attached (attached as redacted stubs):
- redacted-telemetry-snapshot-20261029.tar.gz (contains hashed IDs, /24 IP truncation, and schema mapping)
- ir-timeline-20261102.csv (minute-level timeline extracted from ops notes)
- evidence-fulfillment-20261031.zip (artifact manifest: runbook executions, alerts, and SRE logs)

Tabletop availability (all slots are 30 minutes):
- Tue 2026-11-04 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 2026-11-05 13:00–13:30 PT
- Thu 2026-11-06 15:00–15:30 PT

We performed the pseudonymization per your guidance and excluded any raw key material. Jonas and I ran a brief pre-review; there are three items we flagged for Pratt & Reed: 
1) A single elevated session created by an automation task — we included the associated runbook record and mitigations;
2) A backlog of telemetry ingestion for one shard during the 10/29 window (we included the shard-level ingestion logs and a note on sampling);
3) KMS: confirmed rotation event on 2026-10-30 02:14:22 UTC — summary included in the attached manifest.

Marissa — please review the packaging size and confirm final link to the Drive folder. Jonas — please confirm you'll join the tabletop and own the timeline walk.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Partner, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redacted-telemetry-snapshot-20261029.tar.gz (tar.gz), ir-timeline-20261102.csv (csv), evidence-fulfillment-20261031.zip (zip)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@splendid-fintech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, SAML Security Team <sec@splendid-fintech.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Post-incident summary & final artifacts delivery (Splendid Fintech)

Asha / Splendid team —

Thanks for running the tabletop on 2026-11-05. Per our follow-ups, attached is the finalized postmortem and the full, redacted evidence packet for Pratt & Reed. Summary highlights: 

- Root cause: ingestion delay in shard-03 caused delayed reconciliation of a synthetic auth spike; an automated remediation task created an elevated session that bypassed a recent policy change.
- Impact: <0.1% active sessions affected; no customer data exfiltration detected.
- Remediation: automated remediation task removed, policy enforcement tightened, telemetry sampling and ingestion throttles adjusted.
- KMS: rotation confirmed; no anomalous key access observed.

We have uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive folder (link below) and submitted the SIG->SOC 2 crosswalk (postmortem-summary-20261110.pdf). Per your preference, all artifacts are pseudonymized and IP-truncated. If Pratt & Reed needs deeper access (under a signed NDA with documented controls) we can provide a time-limited, staging environment copy via a dedicated S3 bucket.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHijK_example
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7654321

If you need anything else to close the SOC 2 evidence request, let us know and we'll coordinate directly with Pratt & Reed. Otherwise we'll mark this incident as closed in our IR tracker on 2026-11-12.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Partner, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: postmortem-summary-20261110.pdf (pdf)
